drawn 2-crowds at pad 0 (both squares meet the EXACT unit corner box, interiors disjoint)

Grey = the cell is killed by (B1): no cell of the cover admits an interior-disjoint second meeter of the corner box avoiding K'(first meeter), so the corner is met by at most one square and Lemma K0-FREE teleports the packing into a k >= 1 class.

Green = the cell survives (B1); the shade is the pose-level occupancy p (fraction of sampled realised first meeters in the cell that have a witnessed partner), dark = 1, pale = 0. RED HATCH = p = 0 over the whole sample: alive under the level-1 pair

test but with no witnessed 2-crowd -- the cells a finer cover is expected to kill. Dashed orange square = the corner box [0, a_w]^2; the outer frame is the corner zone [1/2, a_w + sqrt2/2]^2 of admissible centres.
